title: Review artifacts in isolated reviewer context
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `independent_review` recipe. Independent review must not reuse the producer's accumulated reasoning by default. Reviewers see the artifact and acceptance contract; disagreement is retained. Accepts inspiration requirement 10. He walks product steps (instantiate_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
